_comment: Lighting-variant prompts for scripts/comfy_relight_batch.py. Positive text = 'preamble' + variant 'prompt'. Negative text = 'negative_preamble' + variant 'negative' (both optional, default empty). To suppress shadows across a run, put e.g. 'shadows, cast shadows, hard shadows' in negative_preamble and pass --postfix neg_shadow. 'name' becomes part of the output filename, so keep it filesystem-safe.
preamble: Edit only the lighting of the input image. Preserve the exact same objects, geometry, dimensions, camera position, perspective, composition, materials, textures, colors, and background. Do not add, remove, replace, move, reshape, or restyle anything. Change only the illumination.

variants.name: warm_sun_left
variants.prompt: Change only the lighting: warm late-afternoon sunlight entering from the left, strong directional key light, golden color temperature.

variants.name: warm_sun_right
variants.prompt: Change only the lighting: warm late-afternoon sunlight entering from the right, strong directional key light, golden color temperature.

variants.name: cool_overcast
variants.prompt: Change only the lighting: soft, diffuse, cool overcast daylight from above, no visible sun, low contrast, gentle shadows, neutral-to-blue color temperature.

variants.name: harsh_noon
variants.prompt: Change only the lighting: harsh midday sun from directly overhead, bright specular highlights, neutral white daylight.

variants.name: Flat ambient
variants.prompt: Relight with uniform, soft, shadowless ambient illumination at 5500K, as if the scene were in a large overcast diffuser. No directional light, no highlights.

variants.name: Key NE high
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional key light from the upper-right at approximately 45° elevation, 5500K daylight. No fill light.

variants.name: Key NW high
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional key light from the upper-left at approximately 45° elevation, 5500K daylight. No fill light.

variants.name: Key SE low
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional key light from the lower-right at approximately 20° elevation, 5500K daylight. No fill light.

variants.name: Key SW low
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional key light from the lower-left at approximately 20° elevation, 5500K daylight. No fill light.

variants.name: Top-down
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional light from directly above, 5500K daylight.

variants.name: Bottom-up
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard directional light from directly below, 5500K daylight.

variants.name: Front (on-axis)
variants.prompt: Relight with a single hard light from the camera position, collocated with the viewer, 5500K.

variants.name: Warm low-angle
variants.prompt: Relight with a single directional light from the right at approximately 15° elevation, warm 3200K tungsten color. No fill light.

variants.name: Cool low-angle
variants.prompt: Relight with a single directional light from the left at approximately 15° elevation, cool 7500K blue-sky color. No fill light.

variants.name: Bright ambient
variants.prompt: Relight with bright uniform ambient illumination at 5500K, approximately twice as bright as prompt 1, no directional component.

variants.name: Combined NE+SW
variants.prompt: Relight with two hard directional lights simultaneously: one from the upper-right at 45° elevation (5500K) and one from the lower-left at 20° elevation (5500K). Both equal intensity.

outtakes.name: Dim ambient
outtakes.prompt: Relight with dim uniform ambient illumination at 5500K, approximately half as bright as prompt 1, no directional component.

outtakes.name: night_lamp
outtakes.prompt: Change only the lighting: nighttime interior, a single warm artificial lamp as the only light source, dark ambient surroundings, pronounced falloff and warm pooled light near the lamp.

outtakes.name: moody_single_source
outtakes.prompt: Change only the lighting: dramatic low-key illumination from a single hard source at a steep angle, deep shadows, high contrast, cinematic chiaroscuro, neutral color temperature.
